model.note: No local model is configured (TESTFORGE_OLLAMA_MODEL), so it was not asked for scenarios. The template's checks stand on their own.

statements: This was a passive run: it only loaded pages and read what came back, plus one request to a page that cannot exist to see the site's error page. No input was sent, so injection (SQL, script, command) and access control are untested.
Logged-in pages were not checked: nothing here signed in, so anything behind a login is outside this run.
Server configuration that isn't visible over HTTP - TLS settings, patch levels, secrets handling, logging - can't be verified from a browser.
The table below lists the ASVS 5.0 chapters: those a passive run can reach, whether this run tested them, and those out of its reach.

chapters.name: Encoding and Sanitization
chapters.why: needs input sent to the site (the active level)

chapters.name: Validation and Business Logic
chapters.why: needs input sent to the site (the active level)

chapters.name: Web Frontend Security
chapters.why: security headers and cookie attributes are visible on every page load

chapters.name: API and Web Service
chapters.why: needs requests to the site's APIs (the active level)

chapters.name: Session Management
chapters.why: needs logging in and out (the authenticated level)

chapters.name: Self-contained Tokens
chapters.why: needs the tokens a login issues (the authenticated level)

chapters.name: OAuth and OIDC
chapters.why: needs a login flow (the authenticated level)

chapters.name: Secure Communication
chapters.why: 12.2.1: plain-HTTP pages and forms that carry a password are visible

chapters.name: Configuration
chapters.why: 13.4.6: backend version details in response headers are visible

chapters.name: Data Protection
chapters.why: 14.2.1: session tokens and passwords in URLs are visible

chapters.name: Security Logging and Error Handling
chapters.why: 16.5.1: the missing-page probe shows whether an error page leaks internals

chapters.name: WebRTC
chapters.why: needs a WebRTC session (not in this slice)
